svg.title: Robertsonian gamete products
svg.desc: Adjacent-1 segregation yields two rob(14;21) +21 gametes and two -21 gametes. Adjacent-2 yields two rob(14;21) +14 gametes and two -14 gametes. Alternate yields two balanced rob(14;21) gametes and two normal gametes. A +21 gamete can yield a zygote with trisomy 21 after fertilization.
